issue_context.title: Potential overflow when store `ActionTypes` in `schemaDiff`
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/1ddc5927c970166b083a76fe24757a06c099894e/domain/domain.go#L345-L355

See the code above, we used `int64(1<<diff.Type)` to store the ddl type before, but this will overflow when the ddl type is greater than 64 (now the biggest one is 67). IMO, we could store the type directly instead of left shift it.

review_comments: Do we need to update https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/session/schema_amender.go#L46 and https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/session/schema_amender.go#L666 like this?
